Hi Sara, Ben — looping in procurement details so everyone is aligned. Short version: we can accommodate an accelerated settlement for the initial onboarding invoice under the following constraints.

Process & options (standard Redwood vendor setup):
- Vendor onboarding: W-9 + bank details -> vendor record created in Coupa (3-5 business days after docs verified)
- PO: Redwood issues a PO for SOW-based engagements prior to first invoice unless exceptions are authorized by Procurement lead
- Standard payment terms: Net30 (default), alternate: Net45 or Net60 for enterprise partners by contract

Accelerated/early-pay options we can offer:
- Option A: Net15 for first invoice only (one-time) with no discount — requires a PO and Finance approval (timeline: 5–7 business days after PO)
- Option B: Net30 with 1.25% early-pay fee (applies if paid within 15 days) — needs a short addendum and COO approval (timeline: 7–12 business days)
- Option C: Net45 regular cadence, but we can front-load 50% of kickoff invoice on day 30 and settle remaining 20 days later — this is more manual and will require Accounts Payable workflow adjustments

Requirements from TabulaTech to expedite: signed vendor setup form (linked), completed tax docs (W-9 provided), and confirmation whether you require PO number on the invoice. Please note: we cannot net-pay before vendor record is established in the system.

I've attached the vendor setup checklist and a template early-pay addendum. Candidate next steps: Ben to confirm whether Redwood will issue a PO prior to invoice; Sara to confirm which option you prefer.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Setup_Checklist.pdf, Early_Pay_Addendum_Template.docx

Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
